investigations.question: What kills the pilot three times at x~1277-1287 (cluster x~1281, 3 deaths)? Stored evidence has no death cause/events, no input history, no hazard-phase data, and no gameplay frames, and per-run telemetry was not retained so a cross-run repeat is unconfirmed; a mistimed encounter, an unfair hotspot, and a policy defect are all live.

Only if the cluster repeats in captured play may a level edit be proposed.
